title: The Hunter's Arrival
summary: Rank-A Captain Baek Hyeon-Woo arrives at Saint Mirren, sealing the entire university beneath an Anti-Demon Purification Dome. When Enforcers beat Min-Jae outside the cellar, Ha-Jun shatters Jun-Hyuk's blade underground and blasts through the surface to confront Captain Baek.

panels.shot: armored apc military blockade wide shot
panels.action: Armored APCs and black tactical transport vehicles blockade every entrance of Saint Mirren University under stormy skies.
panels.prose_en: Armored APCs and black tactical transport vehicles blockade every entrance of Saint Mirren University under stormy skies.
panels.prose_hi: Bakhtarband apc aur kale samrik parivahan vahan toofani aasman ke neeche sent miren vishwavidyalaya ke har pravesh dwar ko avruddh kar dete han.

panels.shot: captain baek stepping out of command vehicle
panels.action: Captain Baek Hyeon-Woo (tall, silver hair, heavy ceremonial white coat, scarred eye, wielding a massive holy claymore) steps out onto the pavement.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek Hyeon-Woo (tall, silver hair, heavy ceremonial white coat, scarred eye, wielding a massive holy claymore) steps out onto the pavement.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake hyon-woo (lamba, chandi ke bal, bhari aupcharik safed kot, jakhmi aankh, ek vishal pavitra clamor ka upyog karte hue) footpath par kadam rakhta hai.

panels.action: An operative salutes: 'Captain Baek! Agent Jun-Hyuk bees minute pehle auditorium basement mein ghusa tha!'

dialogue.text: Captain Baek! Agent Jun-Hyuk akele andar gaya hai!

panels.prose_en: An operative salutes: 'Captain Baek! Agent Jun-Hyuk bees minute pehle auditorium basement mein ghusa tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek sanchalak salaam karta hai: 'capton bak! agent jun-hyuk bees minute pehle auditorium basement mein ghusa tha!'

panels.action: Captain Baek's scarred eye narrows into an angry scowl: 'Jun-Hyuk hamesha jaldbaazi karta hai. Bina perimeter banaye ghus gaya.'
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek's scarred eye narrows into an angry scowl: 'Jun-Hyuk hamesha jaldbaazi karta hai. Bina perimeter banaye ghus gaya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ki jakhmi aankh gusse mein chillane lagti hai: 'jun-hyuk hamesha jaldbazi karta hai. bina paridhi bane ghus gaya.'

panels.action: Captain Baek draws his colossal holy claymore; the serrated steel pulses with blinding celestial gold and silver mana.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek draws his colossal holy claymore; the serrated steel pulses with blinding celestial gold and silver mana.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ne apna vishal pavitra clamor khincha; chakachaundh kar dene wale divya sone aur chandi ke man ke saath daatedar steel ki daalen.

panels.action: Baek commands: 'Purification Dome deploy karo. Koi bhi student ya teacher bahar na nikalne paaye.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Purification Dome deploy karo! Campus seal karo!

panels.prose_en: Baek commands: 'Purification Dome deploy karo. Koi bhi student ya teacher bahar na nikalne paaye.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak aadesh deta hai: 'shuddhikaran dome tainat karo. 'koi bhi student ya teacher bahar na nikle paye.'

panels.shot: triangular pylons firing golden beam sky
panels.action: Three giant triangular pylon towers fire intense golden laser pillars into the clouds, expanding into a translucent golden dome over the university.
panels.prose_en: Three giant triangular pylon towers fire intense golden laser pillars into the clouds, expanding into a translucent golden dome over the university.
panels.prose_hi: Teen vishal trikoniya toran tower baadalon mein tivra sunhare laser stambhon se fire karte han, jo vishwavidyalaya ke upar ek parabhasi sunhare gumbad mein failte han.

panels.shot: terrified students looking at golden sky
panels.action: Inside classrooms, students and faculty stare out in terror as the sky above their heads becomes an impenetrable golden cage.

dialogue.text: Saint Mirren ek pinjra ban chuka tha.

panels.prose_en: Inside classrooms, students and faculty stare out in terror as the sky above their heads becomes an impenetrable golden cage.
panels.prose_hi: Kakshaon ke ander, chhatra aur shikshak bhaybhit hokar bahar ki or dekhte hain kyonki unke sir ke upar ka aakash ek abhedy sunhare pinjare mein badal jata hai.

panels.action: Behind the old auditorium, Min-Jae stands alone in the howling wind, trembling hands gripping the rusted metal pipe.
panels.prose_en: Behind the old auditorium, Min-Jae stands alone in the howling wind, trembling hands gripping the rusted metal pipe.
panels.prose_hi: Purane sabhagaar ke pichhe, min-je tej hawa mein akele khade han, unke kampate haath zang lage lohe ke pipe ko pakad rahe han.

panels.action: Three Hunter Enforcers in black combat armor, silver visors, and tactical assault rifles round the brick wall.
panels.prose_en: Three Hunter Enforcers in black combat armor, silver visors, and tactical assault rifles round the brick wall.
panels.prose_hi: Int ki deewar ke charon or kale ladaku kavch, chandi ke chhajje aur samrik assault riflon mein teen hunter enforsars.

panels.action: The lead Enforcer raises his assault rifle, red laser dot locking onto Min-Jae's school chest crest: 'Civilian! Darwaze se peechhe hat jao!'

dialogue.text: Civilian! Haath upar karke peechhe hato!

panels.prose_en: The lead Enforcer raises his assault rifle, red laser dot locking onto Min-Jae's school chest crest: 'Civilian! Darwaze se peechhe hat jao!'.
panels.prose_hi: Mukhya enforcer apni assault rifle uthata hai, lal laser dot min-je ke school ke seene par lock karta hai: 'sivilion! darwaze se peeche hat jao!'.

panels.action: Min-Jae's voice trembles, but he refuses to step away from the cellar doors: 'Y-Yahan kuch nahi hai! Main sirf student hoon!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yahan kuch nahi hai! Door raho!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's voice trembles, but he refuses to step away from the cellar doors: 'Y-Yahan kuch nahi hai! Main sirf student hoon!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ki awaaz kampati hai, lekin wah tahkhane ke darwazon se door jaane se inkar karta hai: 'vai-yahan kuch nahin hai! main sirf student hun!'.

panels.action: The Enforcer steps in with a sneer, raising his steel rifle butt to strike Min-Jae down: 'Chupchap rasta chhod, ladke.'
panels.prose_en: The Enforcer steps in with a sneer, raising his steel rifle butt to strike Min-Jae down: 'Chupchap rasta chhod, ladke.'.
panels.prose_hi: Enforsar vyangya ke saath aage aata hai aur min-je ko neeche girane ke liye apni steel rifle but ko upar uthata hai: 'chupchap rasta chhod, ladke.'

panels.action: Min-Jae swings his metal pipe with all his might in a clumsy, desperate arc: 'MAINE KAHA PEECHE HATO!!'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae swings his metal pipe with all his might in a clumsy, desperate arc: 'MAINE KAHA PEECHE HATO!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne lohe ke pipe ko apni puri takat se ek anadi, hatash chaap mein ghumata hai: 'maine kaha peeche hato!!'.

panels.shot: parried pipe and brutal stomach kick
panels.action: The armored Enforcer effortlessly blocks the pipe with his forearm guard and kicks Min-Jae viciously in the ribs.
panels.prose_en: The armored Enforcer effortlessly blocks the pipe with his forearm guard and kicks Min-Jae viciously in the ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Baktarband enforcer aasani se apne agrabahu rakshak ke saath pipe ko avruddh kar deta hai aur min-je ki pasliyon mein buri tarah se laat maarta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae in mud clutching door handle
panels.action: Min-Jae crashes into the wet mud, gasping for air, but his bleeding fingers still cling desperately to the rusted iron door handle: 'Ha-Jun... bhaago...'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae crashes into the wet mud, gasping for air, but his bleeding fingers still cling desperately to the rusted iron door handle: 'Ha-Jun... bhaago...'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je hawa ke liye haanfte hue gili mitti mein gir jata hai, lekin uski khoon se lathpath ungaliyan abhi bhi zang lage lohe ke darwaze ke handle se buri tarah chipki rehti han: 'Ha-Jun... bhago...'.

panels.action: Suddenly, a deep tectonic roar like an erupting volcano shakes the earth beneath their boots: *RUMBLE-KRRRSH!!*
panels.prose_en: Suddenly, a deep tectonic roar like an erupting volcano shakes the earth beneath their boots: *RUMBLE-KRRRSH!!*.
panels.prose_hi: Achanak, futate hue jwalamukhi ki tarah ek gahri tectonic garjana unke jute ke neeche ki dharti ko hila deti hai: *rambal-crarash!!*.

panels.shot: enforcers stumbling as ground fissures open
panels.action: The three Enforcers lose their balance as deep geometric cracks rip across the grass and stone around the cellar doors.
panels.prose_en: The three Enforcers lose their balance as deep geometric cracks rip across the grass and stone around the cellar doors.
panels.prose_hi: Tahkhane ke darwazon ke charon or ghas aur patthar mein gahri jyamitiya dararen padne se teenon pravartak apna santulan kho dete han.

panels.shot: violet hellfire geyser jets through cracks
panels.action: Pillars of radiant violet hellfire jet through the fissures into the cold air, vaporizing falling leaves into ash.
panels.prose_en: Pillars of radiant violet hellfire jet through the fissures into the cold air, vaporizing falling leaves into ash.
panels.prose_hi: Diptiman baingani narkankaal ke khambhe daraaron se thandi hawa mein pravahit hote han, aur girti pattiyon ko raakh mein badal dete han.

panels.action: Cut underground: Ha-Jun's bloodline burns at 100% boiling temperature; violet and crimson mana spirals violently around his silhouette.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ka krodh aag ban chuka tha.

panels.prose_en: Cut underground: Ha-Jun's bloodline burns at 100% boiling temperature; violet and crimson mana spirals violently around his silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Bhumigat katauti: Ha-Jun ki raktarekha 100% ubalte taapmaan par jalti hai; baingani aur lal man uske chhayachitra ke charon or hinsak roop se ghumta hai.

panels.shot: hybrid hunter charging with foaming maw
panels.action: Corrupted hybrid Jun-Hyuk charges with a rabid roar, bringing down his blackened silver blade with two-handed force.
panels.prose_en: Corrupted hybrid Jun-Hyuk charges with a rabid roar, bringing down his blackened silver blade with two-handed force.
panels.prose_hi: Bhrasht hybrid jun-hyuk unmatt dahaad ke saath hamla karta hai, aur apne kale chandi ke blade ko do hathon ke bal se neeche gira deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't dodge: He raises his right hand and catches the descending corrupted blade between two bare crystalline fingers!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't dodge: He raises his right hand and catches the descending corrupted blade between two bare crystalline fingers!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chakma nahin deta: wah apna dahina haath uthata hai aur do nangi crystaliy ungaliyon ke beech utarte hue bhrasht blade ko pakad leta hai!

panels.shot: holy silver blade snapping like dry pasta macro
panels.action: With a casual lateral flick of Ha-Jun's fingers, the thick silver blade snaps clean in half with an explosive ping.
panels.prose_en: With a casual lateral flick of Ha-Jun's fingers, the thick silver blade snaps clean in half with an explosive ping.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyon ke aakasmik parshva jhatke ke sath, moti chandi ki blade ek visfotak ping ke saath aadhi saaf ho jaati hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk's blood-red eyes bulge in sheer paralyzed horror, staring at his snapped blade stub: 'M-Mera holy blade... haath se tod diya?!'
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk's blood-red eyes bulge in sheer paralyzed horror, staring at his snapped blade stub: 'M-Mera holy blade... haath se tod diya?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ki khoon-lal aankhen puri tarah se lakwagrast bhay se ubhari hui han, wah uske toote hue blade stub ko ghoor raha hai: 'm-mera holi bled... haath se tod diya?!'.

panels.shot: sovereign palm strike to hybrid chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun plants his open palm into Jun-Hyuk's chest, detonating a concentrated shockwave of pure violet sovereign mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plants his open palm into Jun-Hyuk's chest, detonating a concentrated shockwave of pure violet sovereign mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni khuli hatheli jun-hyuk ki chhati mein rakh di, jisse shuddh baingani samprabhu man ki ek kendrit shockwev ka visfot hua.

panels.shot: hybrid body launched upward through chute
panels.action: The concussive shockwave launches Jun-Hyuk's 200-pound body straight upward through the stone chute like a projectile.
panels.prose_en: The concussive shockwave launches Jun-Hyuk's 200-pound body straight upward through the stone chute like a projectile.
panels.prose_hi: Consuciv shockwev jun-hyuk ke 200 pound ke shareer ko ek prakshepy ki tarah patthar ki dhalaan ke madhyam se sidhe upar ki or prakshepit karti hai.

panels.action: On the surface: The heavy iron cellar doors blow skyward into shrapnel; Jun-Hyuk's broken body crashes heavily into the mud.
panels.prose_en: On the surface: The heavy iron cellar doors blow skyward into shrapnel; Jun-Hyuk's broken body crashes heavily into the mud.
panels.prose_hi: Satah par: lohe ke bhari tahkhane ke darvaje aakash ki or chharre bankar udte han; jun-hyuk ka toota hua shareer kichad mein buri tarah dhans gaya.

panels.action: The three Enforcers freeze in stunned terror, staring at their broken elite agent coughing blood at their feet: 'Agent Jun-Hyuk?!'

dialogue.text: Agent Jun-Hyuk ko kisne aise maara?!

panels.prose_en: The three Enforcers freeze in stunned terror, staring at their broken elite agent coughing blood at their feet: 'Agent Jun-Hyuk?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Teenon pravartak stabdh aatank mein sthir ho gaye, apne toote hue kulin agent ko apne pairon par khoon khanste hue dekh rahe the: 'agent jun-hyuk?!'.

panels.shot: hajun rising from the cellar smoke
panels.action: Slowly rising from the smoking cellar crater is Ha-Jun Kang, surrounded by a swirling storm of violet mana, eyes burning like twin suns.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mere dost par haath uthane ki himmat kiski hui?

panels.prose_en: Slowly rising from the smoking cellar crater is Ha-Jun Kang, surrounded by a swirling storm of violet mana, eyes burning like twin suns.
panels.prose_hi: Dhune se bhare tahkhane se dhire-dhire Ha-Jun kang nikal raha hai, jo baingani maina ke ghumte toofan se ghira hua hai, aankhen judwan suraj ki tarah jal rahi han.

panels.action: Through the trees, Captain Baek Hyeon-Woo approaches with his glowing golden holy claymore, locking eyes with Ha-Jun across the grass: 'Toh aakhir shaitan ka beej samne aa hi gaya.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Toh aakhir shaitan ka beej samne aa hi gaya.

panels.prose_en: Through the trees, Captain Baek Hyeon-Woo approaches with his glowing golden holy claymore, locking eyes with Ha-Jun across the grass: 'Toh aakhir shaitan ka beej samne aa hi gaya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Pedon ke beech se, captain bake hyon-woo apni chamakti sunhari pavitra clamor ke saath ghas ke paar Ha-Jun ke saath aankhen milate hue aata hai: 'to aakhir shaitan ka beej samne aa hi gaya.'
